text.title: Clownfish
text.safe_tag: Tag, you got it! In Safe mode clownfish nibble algae.
text.bite: A clownfish nipped at you! Swim away!
text.menu_sub: Swim the warm reef, nibble algae, rest in your anemone.
text.menu_wild: Bigger fish swim on the reef.
text.night_hint: It's night. Rest among the soft arms of your anemone.
text.intro: Up and Down to swim. Nibble the algae and tiny animals drifting nearby.
text.hungry: You're hungry. Look for algae and tiny drifting animals near your anemone.
text.no_food: Nothing to eat here. Look for algae and tiny drifting animals near your anemone.
text.about_looks: Bright orange with three white bars across its body. The white bars have black edges.
text.about_food: Nibbles algae and tiny animals that drift in the water.
text.about_home: Lives among the soft arms of its anemone on the reef.
text.about_winter: Stays awake all year and stays close to its anemone.
text.about_young: Babies are born near the anemone. The father stays close and fans the eggs.
text.about_fact: The father fans the eggs to keep them clean.

year.shelter: It stays among the soft arms of its anemone. The anemone is its home.
year.young: Babies are born near the anemone. The father stays close and fans the eggs.

food.spring: Algae, zooplankton, worms and tiny crustaceans.
food.summer: Algae, zooplankton, worms and tiny crustaceans.
food.autumn: Algae, zooplankton, worms and tiny crustaceans.
food.winter: Algae, zooplankton, worms and tiny crustaceans.
